claims.assertion: She says carbon-to-silicon change is a simplified analogy for increasing DNA complexity across perception levels.
claims.speaker: Swaruu Minerva (11)

claims.assertion: She says extraterrestrial science treats elements as frequency variants rather than separate boxes.
claims.speaker: Swaruu Minerva (11)

claims.assertion: She reports human, Taygetan, and Swaruunean DNA as 23/2, 24/12, and 24/24 chromosome/strand counts; she later describes the Swaruunean crystalline mass as 48 chromosomes.
claims.speaker: Swaruu Minerva (11)

claims.assertion: She says Swaruunean crystalline DNA enables unusual state changes, including dematerialization and wall passage.
claims.speaker: Swaruu Minerva (11)

claims.assertion: She says silicon-based life can be non-crystalline and need not imply greater consciousness.
claims.speaker: Swaruu Minerva (11)
